title: MCP Description Effective Protocol View and merge fixture case
description: Structure of each JSON file directly under view-fixtures/. See Sections 4.12 and 4.13 and Proposal 0033.

operation.description: view projects one input to one protocol revision (Section 4.12); merge combines the inputs (Section 4.13).

inputs.description: Input MCP Description documents, as paths relative to this file.

revision.description: The MCP protocol revision of a view case.

expected.description: The expected result document, compared by semantic equivalence (Section 4.13).

expectedFailure.description: The requirement anchor that makes the operation fail instead of returning a document.
